## ProofsModule.autoSelectCredentialsForProofRequest() method

Takes a RetrievedCredentials object and auto selects credentials in a RequestedCredentials object

Use the return value of this method as input to [ProofService.createPresentation()](./core.proofservice.createpresentation.md) to automatically accept a received presentation request.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
autoSelectCredentialsForProofRequest(retrievedCredentials: RetrievedCredentials): RequestedCredentials;
```
